::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 15th 1899  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS  West Sussex County Record Office/ Add. 16,944/5
:::

Dear [Miss Walker](people/person_2234.qmd)
I read a review of [Miss Winslow’s diary](other_books/otherbook_749.qmd), which must have given a fair idea of it. Most [Grandisonian](other_books/otherbook_362.qmd) days those were!  Did you see [‘Like Another Helen’](other_books/otherbook_750.qmd) in which very good imitation letters are written by a young lady who actually was the one woman in the Black Hole.  I thought it the best novel I had seen of the season.  I wonder whether [Gaffer Two Shoes](other_books/otherbook_751.qmd) was an imitation of [Goody](other_books/otherbook_555.qmd).  My cousin has a copy where our prudent Great Grandmother had turned the Ghost in the Church into a dog making arrant nonsense  Did you ever come across  [‘Juliana or the Affectionate Geese.’](other_books/otherbook_764.qmd)  My [Mother](people/person_1626.qmd) once read a part of it, but never saw it again.  Another recollection of hers was of a novel where there was a family of nine Miss Simmondses, and at some county races, on the box of each carriage there was perched a Miss Simmonds  I think we once met a person who likewise remembered the nine Miss Simmondses

I am afraid I must put you off with this short letter for it is a busy day

yours sincerely
C M Yonge
